budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessors reported the levy to be raised for fiscal year 2016.
budget_items.quote: the levy to be raised for fiscal year 2016 is $23,536,237.82.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessors calculated a single tax rate for all classes of property.
budget_items.quote: residential, commercial, industrial and personal property at $19.62 per thousand.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average single family home value rose from fiscal year 2015 to fiscal year 2016.
budget_items.quote: the average single family home value increased from $246,347 in fiscal year 2015 to $256,969 for fiscal year 2016

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average tax bill rose by 11.7% between fiscal years 2015 and 2016.
budget_items.quote: the average tax bill increased by 11.7% from $4,513.08 in fiscal year 2015 to $5041.73 in fiscal year 2016

budget_items.topic: School project debt share of tax increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Of the average bill increase, 66% came from debt repayment for the Lunenburg Middle/High School project, amounting to $349.48 on the average tax bill.
budget_items.quote: of this $528.65 increase, 66% results from the debt repayment for the lunenburg middle/high school project, amounting to $349.48 on the average tax bill.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town has one more borrowing to do, sometime in January 2016, for the school project, with an amount described as a range.
budget_items.quote: ranging between four and six million dollars

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Change order #5 for auditorium grading and bollards was about $8200.00, bringing the running total of change orders to $170,000 out of the contingency fund.
budget_items.quote: total change order is around $8200.00 bringing the running total of change orders to $170,000 out of the 4 million dollar contingency

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed four warrants with the amounts printed.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $338,946.13; school construction warrant for $2,976,960.20; payroll warrant in the amount of $722,184.63 and payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $152,581.81.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board of Health held a workshop on loan program guidelines and aims to start the program in spring 2016; no dollar figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: board of health held a workshop regarding the septic system repair loan program guidelines

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Luck said the Eagle Scout ramp project is still seeking funding; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: boy scout logan marshall is still seeking funding for his eagle scout project
